senses.definitionEn: Used by the speaker or writer to refer to himself or herself as the subject of a verb.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I like learning English every day.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Me gusta aprender inglés todos los días.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: I would appreciate it if you could send me the report.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Agradecería que pudiera enviarme el informe.

senses.definitionEn: To perform an action, activity, or task.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I always do my homework after school.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Siempre hago mis deberes después del colegio.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Scientists continue to do extensive research on renewable energy.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Los científicos continúan haciendo una investigación exhaustiva sobre energías renovables.

phrasalVerbs.example1: The company decided to do away with paper forms.
phrasalVerbs.example2: Many old regulations were done away with last year.

phrasalVerbs.example1: You made a mistake, so you need to do it over.
phrasalVerbs.example2: We have to do the kitchen over next month.
